units.title: Unit 2: How We Express Ourselves
units.subtitle: Persuasion, Media, and Communication
units.description: Explore how we express ideas, persuade others, and present strong evidence.

strategies.title: Ethos (Trust & Credibility)
strategies.explanation: Ethos shows your reader that you are trustworthy, experienced, and knowledgeable about your topic!

starters.starter: You can trust me when I say ......
examples: You can trust me when I say this is the tastiest ice cream in town.
You can trust me when I say these stickers stick perfectly without ripping.
You can trust me when I say my popcorn is the best in town.
I have been collecting and designing colorful stickers for years.
I have been practicing making ice cream for a long time.
I have been baking delicious cookies with my grandmother since I was five.
I have worked hard in the kitchen choosing only fresh ingredients to make every scoop.
I have worked hard to test this is the most fun game for everyone.
I have worked hard making sure my nachos are perfectly crispy.

starters.starter: You can believe me when I say ......
examples: You can believe me when I say these homemade treats are made with real care.
You can believe me when I say these stickers are top quality.
You can believe me when I say you will love my nachos.
I promise you can believe in the quality of my fresh ice cream.
I promise that you will want more of my ice cream.
I promise these toys are safe and easy for everyone to use.

strategies.title: Pathos (Emotions & Feelings)
strategies.explanation: Pathos connects with your reader's feelings, like happiness, excitement, relief, or delight, to make them care about your product!

examples: Imagine taking a big gulp of ice-cold fruit juice on a hot sunny day and feeling instantly refreshed.
Imagine walking into movie night and smelling warm, buttery popcorn popped fresh just for you.
Imagine sitting at your desk during a hard test and feeling instantly calm as you click your silent clicker.
Picture your friends looking at your colorful juice box and wishing they had a sweet, fruity treat too.
Picture your family sharing a giant bowl of crunchy popcorn while watching your favorite movie together.
Picture sitting calmly in class, relaxing while your fidget clicker keeps your hands busy and your mind focused.
Doesn't that feeling of cold, sweet juice on your tongue make you smile instantly?
Doesn't that feeling of warm, salty butter and crunch bring total happiness with every handful?
Doesn't that feeling of relief and focus make studying feel so much easier and less stressful?

strategies.title: Logos (Facts & Logic)
strategies.explanation: Logos uses logic, clear facts, and strong reasoning to prove to your reader why your idea makes complete sense!

examples: My juice contains 100% real fruit juice, no added refined sugar, and full daily vitamins.
My nachos contains no artificial colorings, no strange preservatives, and real melted cheddar cheese.
My squishies contains durable non-toxic silicone that easily restores its shape after thousands of squeezes.
Studies show that fidget clickers help students maintain focus and lower stress during class.
Studies show that drinking fresh juice improves energy levels and helps kids stay active all day.
Studies show that squishy toys provide calming sensory input that improves mood.

starters.starter: When we tested this product, we found that ......
examples: When we tested this product, we found that our homemade cheese sauce stayed warm and extra melty for over thirty minutes.
When we tested this product, we found that our fresh fruit juice gave students a natural energy boost without any sugar crashes.
When we tested this product, we found that it clicked over 500 times without jamming or making loud noises during study time.
Doesn't it make sense to choose a snack that is both crunchy and packed with real energy?
Doesn't it make sense to buy a silent clicker that lasts all school year without breaking?
Doesn't it make sense to pick a drink that tastes delicious and keeps your body healthy?
It makes sense to select squishies because they are affordable, reusable, and great for sharing.
It makes sense to buy clickers because they are quiet, durable, and practical for learning.
It makes sense to serve fresh nachos made with quality ingredients everyone enjoys.

tools.title: Pathos One Line Advert Examples
tools.subtitle: Short emotional slogans that catch your reader's attention instantly
tools.explanation: Pathos connects with your audience's feelings, excitement, happiness, and desires in just one powerful sentence!

adverts.tagline: Feel the burst of pure happiness in every ice-cold sip!
Squeeze away your stress and bring an instant smile to your day!
Treat your taste buds to the ultimate crunchy bite of pure joy!
Turn quiet study time into a relaxing, focus-boosting adventure!
Show the world your unique style with designs that make you shine!
